facts.fact: ALT Advisory's Data Protection Africa fact sheet for Cote d'Ivoire lists the Malabo Convention as ratified; it gives no ratification date, so the page's last-updated date of 23 May 2022 is used.
The same fact sheet lists the ECOWAS Supplementary Act on Personal Data Protection as signed by Cote d'Ivoire, with no date given, so the page's last-updated date of 23 May 2022 is used.
facts.system: ECOWAS Supplementary Act on Personal Data Protection
